products.name: The Espresso Tailored Suit
products.description:
A deep espresso blazer and matching wide-leg trousers create a polished two-piece suit. Notched lapels, a defined waist and a fluid trouser shape make it an easy choice for work or dressed-up occasions.

Two-piece suit: blazer and trousers. Top, hijab, belt, shoes, bag and jewelry are styling accessories.

products.name: The Black Contrast Track Set
products.description:
A black zip-front track jacket and relaxed wide-leg trousers, finished with crisp white side stripes. Wear the pieces together for an easy off-duty look or style them separately with everyday essentials.

Two-piece set: jacket and trousers. Top, trainers and accessories are not included.

products.name: The Ivory Gold-Button Knit Set
products.description:
An ivory ribbed collared cardigan pairs with a matching long skirt for a softly coordinated look. Gold-tone buttons and a front skirt slit add definition to the clean, tonal silhouette.

Two-piece set: cardigan and skirt. Belt, shoes, bag and jewelry are styling accessories.

products.name: The Chocolate Gold-Button Jacket
products.description:
A cropped chocolate jacket with a pointed collar, patch pockets and gold-tone buttons. Its structured silhouette adds a smart finishing layer to high-rise trousers, denim or a simple dress.

Jacket only. Knit top, trousers, belt, shoes, bag and jewelry are not included.

products.name: The Midnight Draped Satin Gown
products.description:
A black satin-look maxi dress with slender straps, a draped neckline and a defined bodice. Gathering through the skirt and a high side slit create an elegant evening silhouette.

Dress only. Shoes, clutch and jewelry are not included.

products.name: The Navy Modern Tailored Suit
products.description:
A navy notched-lapel blazer and matching wide-leg trousers offer a versatile take on modern tailoring. The clean lines work equally well with a simple camisole or a fine knit.

Two-piece suit: blazer and trousers. Top, belt, shoes, bag and jewelry are styling accessories.

products.name: The Sand Cropped Tailored Blazer
products.description:
A sand-toned blazer with a shorter hem, defined shoulders and classic notched lapels. Its compact shape pairs naturally with high-waisted, wide-leg trousers for a balanced everyday silhouette.

Blazer only. Knit top, trousers, belt, shoes, bag and jewelry are not included.

products.name: The Mocha Blossom Maxi Dress
products.description:
A cream maxi dress scattered with warm mocha florals. A wrap-effect neckline, tie waist, gathered sleeves and tiered skirt create a flowing silhouette for daytime occasions and relaxed celebrations.

Dress only. Shoes, bag and jewelry are not included.

products.name: The Sand Longline Trench
products.description:
A long sand-toned trench with broad lapels, a double-breasted front and adjustable cuff straps. The generous length creates an understated outer layer over tailoring or casual separates.

Coat only. Hijab, top, trousers, belt, shoes, bag and jewelry are styling accessories.

products.name: The Chocolate Longline Blazer
products.description:
A chocolate blazer with a longer cut, notched lapels and flap pockets. Its softly structured shape brings warmth and definition to cream trousers, denim and everyday neutral layers.

Blazer only. Knit top, trousers, belt, shoes, bag and jewelry are not included.

products.name: The Cocoa Asymmetric Draped Dress
products.description:
A cocoa occasion dress with an asymmetric neckline and sculptural draping across the bodice. Side gathering shapes the waist and falls into a long skirt with a wrap-effect opening.

Dress only. Shoes, clutch and jewelry are not included.

products.name: The Espresso Pleated Trousers
products.description:
Deep espresso trousers with a high-rise shape, front pleats and a full wide-leg cut. Their understated tailoring pairs easily with a flowing blouse, simple knit or matching-toned jacket.

Trousers only. Blouse, hijab, belt, shoes and jewelry are not included.

products.name: The Oat Half-Zip Lounge Set
products.description:
An oat-toned textured knit set with a collared half-zip top and matching relaxed trousers. Ribbed trims and a soft, roomy silhouette make it an effortless choice for quieter days.

Two-piece set: knit top and trousers. Trainers, bag and jewelry are not included.
